taxi.title: Taxis
taxi.text: Taxi counters are in the domestic and international arrivals areas. Staff direct the passenger and driver to a designated car park within the airport; one of the service’s published phone numbers is +51 1 4844001.

lounges.title: The Club LIM Internacional
lounges.text: The Club LIM Internacional lounge is on Level 2 in international departures. It has relaxation spaces, a bar, showers and meeting rooms. The airport lists the lounge as open 24 hours a day, every day.

sleep.title: Sleepover
sleep.text: Sleepover is on Level 2 of Perú Plaza, next to Starbucks and Dunkin Donuts, and is open around the clock. It offers showers, nap capsules, cabins with bunk beds, a coworking area and included drinks.

wifi.title: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.text: You can connect to .FreeWifiJorgeChavez free of charge on a phone or laptop. To access it, accept the terms of use on the connection page.
